n: Two posts from one lab on one day: a 40% government discount, now used by about 500 federal, state and local organizations, and a drug pipeline counted in tested variants with a date for human trials. Read the numbers a post commits to (a dollar estimate, a count, a year) and check back when the date arrives. Also: on Oct. 26 OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, a model built for visual reasoning and computer use, and on Oct. 28 Axiom announced a computer-checked version of the classification of finite simple groups in the Lean proof language, which it says ran to about 43 million lines built in 24 days with AI agents.
